WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 6
), sales AS (
  SELECT p.category, f.net_amount AS net_amt, f.standard_cost AS cost_amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date
  WHERE p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id <> 999
), rets AS (
  SELECT p.category, -r.refund_net AS net_amt, -r.standard_cost_returned AS cost_amt
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date
  WHERE p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id <> 999
), u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period, category, round(sum(net_amt),2) AS net_sales_eur, round(100*(sum(net_amt)-sum(cost_amt))/sum(net_amt),2) AS gross_margin_pct,
  round(sum(net_amt) FILTER (WHERE net_amt>0),2) AS sales_before_returns
FROM u GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
